title: platform-objects sys_member.transfer_ownership promises the previous owner is demoted to admin; better-auth's update-member-role writes only the target, so the organization ends with two owners
body:
Filing gate ①: class (a), a public door whose declared promise is false, measured. Filed by `repo:cloud#2` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2912 dev report (cloud PR #3003). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

On a booted cloud control plane at framework pin `be076dad28a0`, an organization owner runs `sys_member`'s `transfer_ownership` row action (the organization record page's 成员 row menu offers it). It sends `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/update-member-role` with `{ memberId: TARGET, role: 'owner', organizationId }`.
- **Measured:** the request answers 2xx. The target's `sys_member.role` becomes `owner`, and the caller's role **stays `owner`**. The cloud dev's booted run failed with `expected 'owner' to be 'admin', received 'owner'`, at about 2026-10-18T06:48Z.
- **What the action declares** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts`, pin and `main`):
  - the comment at `:231` says it "auto-demotes the previous owner";
  - the `confirmText` at `:259` tells the user "You will be demoted to admin and lose owner-only privileges."
- **What the runtime does:** better-auth 1.7.3 `dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-members.mjs` `updateMemberRole` (about `:236-340`) writes only the target member's role.

So the user confirms a transfer, and the organization ends with two owners. The user believes they gave up owner privileges, but they kept them.

## Wanted (the lane picks the shape)

Declared is enforced. Either:
- the action does what it says: a platform door that sets the target to `owner` and the caller to `admin` in one write, refused when the caller is not an owner; or
- the action stops promising it: the text and the comment say it adds an owner. Then ownership transfer is a separate, honest step.

Plus a booted test that reads both rows after the action.

Dedupe: semantic search of this repository for `transfer_ownership`, `demoted to admin`, `update-member-role owner`: no open match. #8289 (closed) is `remove-member`'s wrong status, not this.
